source.head: feature/order-fraud-hold
source.title: Orders (NestJS): hold high-risk orders for fraud review
source.intent:
Orders: hold high-risk orders for fraud review; loyalty discounts; carrier status from events
- New FraudService scores every order with the risk provider. Orders scoring 0.8 or more,
  or above 5000 for standard-tier customers, are held: no stock reservation, orders.held
  instead of orders.created and no confirmation email.
- POST /orders/:id/release lets a reviewer release a held order; fraud.decisions events
  from the fraud desk approve (release) or reject (cancel) held orders.
- The checkout quote preview says whether the order would need review.
- Gold and platinum customers get a 5% / 10% loyalty discount.
- Tracking comes from shipments.status carrier events instead of calling the carrier API
  on every order read.
- Receipts are only queued for succeeded payments.
